metadata.value: We are writing a white paper on this topic, primarily composed of a set of individual science cases that are either very important, and somehow stress the observing strategy, and describing how we expect them to be sensitive to LSST observing strategy. MAF metric calculations are then being designed and implemented: these form the quantitative backbone of the document.
